description: The file 'seama.c' contains C source code implementing functionalities for working with SEAMA headers in memory technology device (MTD) images. It includes functions for fixing MD5 checksums, updating header sizes, and performing read/write/erase operations on MTD devices related to SEAMA headers.

methods.name: int seama_fix_md5(struct seama_entity_header * shdr,int fd,size_t data_offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum of a SEAMA entity within a device image, fixing the checksum if necessary.

methods.name: int mtd_fixseama(const char * mtd,size_t offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Main function to locate a SEAMA header in an MTD device, verify and fix its MD5 checksum, and possibly update header size details.
